purpose: Teach: 市中/汝/減退/ゴシップ/小声/快挙/真田/悪戯

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、市中、つまり市中銀行の金融研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, in your thesis you took up financial research on commercial banks — the ones out in the market — didn't you.
lines.style: Measured teacher's opening, warm and precise, slight lift on his name, unhurried confirming cadence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、聖書の汝、つまり「汝」の二人称研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I also covered the biblical 'thou,' research on that old second-person pronoun, in my paper.
lines.style: Quick earnest 'yes,' slightly nervous energy, careful enunciation like reciting a prepared answer.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、高齢者の体力減退の医学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you dealt with medical research on physical decline in the elderly as well, Ren.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slower pace, gently checking the list, soft downward intonation at the end.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、メディアのゴシップ報道の倫理研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered research on the ethics of gossip reporting in the media too.
lines.style: Prompt and eager, a touch breathless, keen to show he has kept everything straight.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、図書館での小声、つまり小声会話の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also took up the study on whispering — hushed conversation in libraries — didn't you, Ren.
lines.style: Mildly amused warmth on 'whispering,' voice dropping playfully quieter, then steady teacher's cadence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、宇宙開発の快挙、つまり成功例の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, and research on the great feats of space development — the success stories.
lines.style: Brightening on 'space,' genuine enthusiasm creeping past the formality, faster toward the end.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦国武将真田氏の戦術研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And the study of the tactics of the Sanada clan, the Warring States commanders — that was yours too, Ren.
lines.style: Quiet appreciation, deliberate pacing on the historical names, a slight impressed pause before the end.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、児童の悪戯、つまり悪戯心理の発達研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — and lastly, developmental research on children's mischief, the psychology behind their pranks.
lines.style: Relieved final answer, small smile in the voice, tension easing as the review wraps.
